channel.title: RateLog — Cursor changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Cursor, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Cursor — Teams split into two seat tiers
item.description: [↑ improved] Standard keeps its $40/seat price but gains materially more included usage, split into first-party and third-party model pools. A new $120/seat Premium tier (5× Standard’s usage) was added for heavy daily users.

item.title: Cursor — Teams moved to usage-based billing
item.description: [changed] Teams moved from a fixed per-request cost (250 included requests/month/seat, $0.08 per extra request) to variable, API-rate usage billing.

item.title: Cursor — Pro moved off flat "500 fast requests"
item.description: [changed] Cursor dropped the old flat ‘500 fast requests/month’ Pro model for usage-based pricing: Pro now includes at least $20/month of inference at API prices and unlimited use of the 'Auto' model. Also launched the $200/month Ultra tier.
